title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative:
The Cameroon climate action project in the Far North Region works with schools to better understand their priorities, needs, expectations, and actions for adaptation to climate change. The project aims to enhance the participation of children with disabilities in existing child-to-child clubs, school councils, and school civic clubs through discussions and debates on climate action. We train inclusion champions in schools and social workers on climate change and climate disasters, focusing on mitigation, adaptation, and resilience. Teachers in inclusive schools are trained on providing psychosocial support to children affected by trauma due to climate and climate related conflict. Adaptation: - The project will respond specifically to climate related emergencies, displacement and conflict trauma in children in participating inclusive schools to support their learning, development and provide referral for psychosocial support.
- Training of inclusion champions, teachers and social workers on climate change and how to take care of those children will increase awareness on climate related impacts and how to support children impacted by climate related trauma.
